celestial.name: Celestial Earrings
celestial.blurb: Arzano's most recognisable designs: cascades and clusters that frame the face.

nova.name: Nova Cascade
nova.blurb: Miniature diamonds woven by master artisans into necklaces that fall like water.

comet.name: Comet Precious Stones
comet.blurb: Vivid gemstones clustered with diamonds for a design that lasts beyond any season.

cassiopeia.name: Cassiopeia Cocktail
cassiopeia.blurb: One-of-a-kind cocktail pieces in glimmering combinations of gems.

hailey.name: Hailey's Bridal
hailey.blurb: Bridal sets made to celebrate the most important moments of a woman's life.

melange.name: Mélange
melange.blurb: Marquise, pear and brilliant-cut diamonds gathered into one piece, made for every day.

toujours.name: Toujours
toujours.blurb: Little treasures to wear every day and keep forever.

pieces.name: Cascade Drop Earrings
pieces.alt: Model wearing a long cascade earring of pear and marquise diamonds
pieces.desc: A single line of pear and marquise diamonds that falls almost to the shoulder. This is the Arzano cascade in its purest form, the same silhouette Ana de Armas wore to the Academy Awards.

pieces.name: Double-Strand Pear Necklace
pieces.alt: Double-strand diamond necklace ending in a pear-shaped drop
pieces.desc: Two rivers of diamonds that meet in a pear-shaped drop. Quiet brilliance, made for evening.

pieces.name: The Grand Rivière
pieces.alt: Five-row cascading necklace of pear, marquise and emerald-cut diamonds
pieces.desc: Five cascading rows of pear, marquise and emerald-cut diamonds. The house's most dramatic statement, made once and never repeated.

pieces.name: Pear Riviera Necklace
pieces.alt: Crown-like collar of graduated pear diamonds
pieces.desc: Graduated pear diamonds arranged in a crown-like collar. First shown at Baselworld.

pieces.name: Emerald Cluster Drops
pieces.alt: Emerald drop earrings framed by marquise and pear diamonds
pieces.desc: Vivid emerald-cut emeralds framed by a flurry of marquise and pear diamonds.

pieces.name: Cluster Hoop Earrings
pieces.alt: Open hoop earring of pear and marquise diamonds
pieces.desc: An open hoop of pear and marquise diamonds that frames the face from every angle.

pieces.name: Cocktail Ring Edit
pieces.alt: Hand wearing diamond flower cluster rings and an emerald cocktail ring
pieces.desc: Flower clusters, an emerald centre and stacked bands. Made to be worn together, the more the better.

pieces.name: Everyday Diamond Rings
pieces.alt: Fine diamond solitaire rings stacked on the fingers
pieces.desc: Little treasures to be worn every day and cherished forever. Brilliant and pear solitaires on fine bands.

pieces.name: Mélange Ribbon Bracelet
pieces.alt: Mélange bracelet of marquise, pear and round diamonds
pieces.desc: Smooth as silk, filled with marquise, pear and brilliant-cut diamonds. This is the piece that defines Mélange.

pieces.name: Mélange Necklace
pieces.alt: Fine necklace of mixed-shape diamonds worn at the collarbone
pieces.desc: A fine line of mixed-shape diamonds that sits close to the collarbone. Elegance with a twist.

pieces.name: Mélange Eternity Bands
pieces.desc: Unbroken lines of diamonds. Beautiful alone and even better in a stack.

pieces.name: Diamond Flex Bangles
pieces.alt: Diamond bangles in white, rose and yellow gold
pieces.desc: Elegant on its own and made for stacking, in white, rose and yellow gold.

pieces.name: Tennis Bracelet Duo
pieces.alt: Two diamond tennis bracelets worn together on the wrist
pieces.desc: Classic beauty that lasts forever. Two lines of brilliance, worn together.

pieces.name: Teardrop Pendant
pieces.alt: Black-and-white portrait of a pear diamond pendant on a fine diamond chain
pieces.desc: A single pear diamond suspended from a fine diamond line. Chosen by brides who want one perfect stone.
